full_reasoning:
Loop 4 of the position-tier-gate / full-trace arm. Prior context: loops 1-3 full_reasoning + NOTES.md.

Loops 1-3 findings: cap=2 = simple; streak gate = no-op; flow gate (30s) hurts (-17.28%). Loop 4 hypothesis: shorter flow window (5s) may hurt less than 30s because it's more selective (only skips when very recent flow is adverse, not 30s of accumulated flow).

Result: ptg-f-l4 (5s flow gate + cap=1) pnl=$3,266.50, -23.37% vs base, trades=78,436. Worse than loop 3 (30s flow gate was -17.28%). Shorter window = WORSE. The 5s flow gate is even more aggressive at filtering — it fires more often because short-window flow is noisier and more often adverse. Both 5s and 30s flow gates degrade the already-optimal ptg base.

Key finding: Flow gates (both short and long windows) degrade the ptg base. The ptg base at cap=1 selects entries through position serialization; the flow gate removes additional trades without P&L benefit. No flow window improves over the base.
